hardware.cpu: ARMv8 (64-bit) Family 8 Model 1 Revision 201, Qualcomm Technologies Inc

why_not_representative: a development workstation running the tooling. docs/12 P8 showed this class of host cannot hold an absolute latency figure still. The RATIO is the result; the absolutes are recorded and must not be quoted as service latency
ratio_transferability: READ THIS BEFORE USING THE RATIO. A ratio cancels host NOISE - thermal drift, another process arriving - because the noise moves both arms together. It does NOT cancel a systematic per-FORMAT difference between hosts, and instruction-set support for int8 is exactly that. Cascade Lake has AVX-512 VNNI, which accelerates int8 convolution and does nothing for fp32; this box has no VNNI at all. So a ratio measured here is not transferable to the service host, and the projection built on it below is an ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE sanity check for deciding whether to spend money - never an answer

fp32.reported: the SLOWEST of the repeats, not the mean and not the best

int8.reported: the SLOWEST of the repeats, not the mean and not the best

ratio.reported: paired_median - the median of the per-cycle ratios, which is what alternating the arms buys

decision.rule: spend the GCE run only if R < 50 / 18.252 = 2.74 (pre-registered)
